items.name: fireplace_flames_flames
items.prompt: Remove the flames of the Flames and glowing logs inside the stone fireplace. Show the fuel without flames: the split logs on the grate glowing orange with embers between them and a dark sooty back wall lit warm, glowing softly, with the same warm light on the surroundings. No flames, no smoke. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the same painting style, lighting, colors, perspective and level of detail. Do not add any new objects.

_note: AI edit of the key art (painted transients removed); see tools/plate_clean.py
